reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001330 (the melody read from 001330a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 17); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Charles Zeuner has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1839, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001330a.nwc).
